method: Batch 50 (mobresist, b50mr): the PlayerDamageProbe double runs the unchanged attackEntityFrom (sv.a) on a real EntityZombie (yq: natural armour 2) for 22 DamageSources (the 21 of b49fa plus causePlayerDamage) at amounts 1 and 6, with leather, iron or diamond armour in the four armour slots, Protection, Fire Protection, Feather Falling, Blast Protection or Projectile Protection on every piece, the Resistance potion (0, 1, 4) and absorption hearts (sv.m). The player rows run the same on the real EntityPlayerMP with PvP enabled on the server double, for a player attacker and a mob attacker. EnchantmentHelper.a (static Random) is seeded per record. armor = each armour piece damage after; absorbed = absorption hearts left (sv.bs).
